resource_reservation_scope: Global actual actor/vehicle IDs from the referenced shared policy. Port job limits do not create workers. One inbound forklift pair cannot serve two ports simultaneously.

assumptions.L03_SYNTHETIC_PORT_PARAMETERS: Service points and clear gate dimensions are synthetic candidates, not measured dimensions or loaded-clearance certification.
assumptions.L03_SYNTHETIC_SERVICE: Times, one-job bays, buffer count ceilings and 8-hour open windows are synthetic per-handling-unit intake assumptions; no throughput or engine KPI claim.
assumptions.handling_units: A handling unit is not a SKU unit, lot or pick visit. Its dimensions, mass and packing rule must come from explicit cargo metadata.
assumptions.reference: R07 v2 supplies concept context; its 4.5m clear large-gate illustration is not engineering proof.

ports.position_semantics: Floor centre of boundary opening, XYZ metres.
ports.service_position_semantics: Floor contact/service reference inside the protected approach; no parked cargo buffer here.
ports.clearance_rule: Allowed family is not loaded admission. Actual load dimensions, orientation, support, handler payload and swept path must pass L05 and subsequent cargo/route checks. Missing checks do not imply a fit.

finite_buffer_capacity.admission_rule: Count ceiling AND actual footprint/orientation/payload compatibility of the assigned finite staging area; count alone never guarantees fit.
finite_buffer_capacity.blocking_rule: Reserve an admissible staging position before intake. When none is available, hold upstream; no cargo waits in the keep-clear approach or teleports to storage.

service_time_rule.scope: Synthetic intake/unload/check/release to reserved staging; excludes resource travel, queueing, putaway and other operational legs.
service_time_rule.resource_motion: Actual actor/vehicle travel and exclusive reservations must appear separately in the source-labelled timeline.

ports.window_rule: Synthetic 8-hour opening intersected with the supplied run horizon; no arrivals or work are generated by this definition.

source_of_assumption.coordinates: V3 brief section3, retained from accepted L02 port context and R07 v2.
